tool.name: vcs.review
tool.title: Review a pull request
tool.description: Submit one review (COMMENT or REQUEST_CHANGES; APPROVE only where the host owner allows it, and then only when every check run on the head succeeded: approve_checks_missing, approve_checks_pending or approve_checks_failed otherwise, naming the checks) on a pull request of an allowed repository. The same client_key never reviews twice. Needs repo:<alias>.

record_id.description: The work record this review is for (ADR-034 receipt evidence). Recorded in the receipt only; never sent to the host.
